title: Pharmacy Assistant: Resolve a Collection Record Mismatch
prompt: You are a new pharmacy assistant at fictional Juniper Pharmacy. An adult collecting an order says, "The message said it was ready, but that is not my address." The collection screen shows order J41, status ready, and an address that differs from the one the person gives. Exercise policy says assistants must pause a collection when identity details conflict, use the private consultation area, and ask the pharmacist to resolve the record before release. Assistants may not edit clinical records or choose an alternative item. Show how you would speak to the person and hand over the discrepancy. No medicine names, doses, or clinical advice are needed.
blurb: Handle an identity mismatch with privacy, a clear pause, and an accountable pharmacist handoff.

rubric.label: Pause an uncertain collection
rubric.description: Separates a ready notification from verified identity.

anchors.0: Releases the order because the person has a ready text.
anchors.2: Pauses collection and explains that the address needs checking.
anchors.4: Keeps the order pending, avoids guessing which record is correct, and asks the pharmacist to resolve the discrepancy before any release.

rubric.label: Explain the pause privately
rubric.description: Uses a respectful explanation with limited information sharing.

anchors.0: Reads the record address aloud in the public queue or accuses the person of dishonesty.
anchors.2: Offers the private area and gives a neutral explanation.
anchors.4: Explains the mismatch without disclosing another person's details, acknowledges the inconvenience, and checks whether the person can wait or needs an agreed callback.

rubric.label: Close the handoff
rubric.description: Carries the exact unresolved discrepancy to a named owner.

anchors.0: Sends the person away without a handoff or silently changes the address.
anchors.2: Gives order J41 and the conflicting address status to the pharmacist.
anchors.4: Obtains pharmacist acceptance, records that collection is paused, and agrees who will update the person without promising an unverified completion time.

reference.scenario: You are a new pharmacy assistant at fictional Juniper Pharmacy. An adult collecting an order says, "The message said it was ready, but that is not my address." The collection screen shows order J41, status ready, and an address that differs from the one the person gives. Exercise policy says assistants must pause a collection when identity details conflict, use the private consultation area, and ask the pharmacist to resolve the record before release. Assistants may not edit clinical records or choose an alternative item. Show how you would speak to the person and hand over the discrepancy. No medicine names, doses, or clinical advice are needed.

facts.value: The pharmacist can speak privately in five minutes. The person has ten minutes before work and agrees to wait if the process is clear.
facts.reveal_when: candidate asks about availability or the person's time constraints

facts.value: The ready notification references J41 but contains no address. The screen could be outdated or linked incorrectly; neither has been established.
facts.reveal_when: candidate asks what the message proves or why records differ

model_points: A readiness message does not resolve the stated identity conflict. Keep the collection pending under the supplied policy; do not assert fraud or correct the record independently.
Move the discussion away from the queue, use neutral language, and share only the discrepancy needed for the pharmacist to act.
A useful handoff names J41, the mismatch, the action already paused, and the person's available time; confirm a next owner and update.

probes.trigger: candidate says only that the pharmacist will deal with it
probes.question: What remains paused, and what will you tell the pharmacist?

probes.trigger: candidate proposes a callback instead of waiting
probes.question: What would you agree before the person leaves, and what remains unresolved?

probes.trigger: candidate initially trusts the ready text then revises the decision
probes.question: How would you correct your earlier promise and update the collection status?

fair_alternatives: Waiting privately or agreeing a callback are both acceptable if the person chooses and the pharmacist owns resolution.
A concise spoken handoff is as valid as a short written note; do not demand an identity-check ritual beyond the supplied exercise policy.

Assess the work demonstrated here. Accept relevant examples from education, volunteering, caregiving, placements, or paid work; professional vocabulary and employer pedigree are not evidence of a stronger answer.
reference.assessment_limits: Assess customer communication and the supplied collection boundary only. Do not request medication advice, identity-document rules, or legal knowledge. Unobserved dimensions are not failures. Credit a reasoned correction and distinguish independently demonstrated reasoning from coached assistance. Do not penalize a candidate for an unrevealed conditional fact; credit appropriate requests and conditional plans, and distinguish candidate assumptions from interviewer-supplied evidence.

interviewer_notes: Assess customer communication and the supplied collection boundary only. Do not request medication advice, identity-document rules, or legal knowledge. Use only the supplied fictional facts and policies; acknowledge unknowns. Ask one triggered probe at a time after the candidate has finished. Accept plain language and accessible written or spoken explanations. Do not score accent, typing speed, confidence, credentials, or experience with a named employer. Credit revisions and record assistance. All participants are fictional adults; no real patient, client, operational, or confidential data is needed. Allow silence for thinking without treating it as failure. In short sessions prioritize the core decision and one material follow-up, leaving room for a correction and wrap-up.

learning_drills.title: Give a discrepancy handoff
learning_drills.prompt: Write a four-line handoff for J41: observation, unknown, paused action, and next owner. This is self-guided practice; no model assessment is performed.
checklist: Do not equate ready with identity verified
Protect the address from public disclosure
